n: Makey Makey Spanish dual language lesson plan
t: A lesson plan that builds Spanish pronunciation games in Scratch with Makey Makey.
steps: Find the Spanish (Dual Language) Lesson Plan on the Makey Makey site.
Gather Makey Makey boards, alligator clips, tinfoil, playdough, and conductive foods.
Open Scratch in a browser on each computer.
Review the Game Controller Challenge first.
Start the Rookie track with conductive material tests.
Have pairs test games for pronunciation.
Plan a family and staff event for the Advanced track.
